items.author: Musk
items.text: J.P. Morgan Called a Potential Elon Musk SpaceX-Tesla Merger "Strategically Coherent"
items.summary_cn: 摩根大通称Musk旗下SpaceX与Tesla的潜在合并具有'战略一致性'，涉及TSLA及SpaceX相关持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX sell-off wipes $1tn from Elon Musk’s rocket group
items.summary_cn: SpaceX二级市场抛售抹去Musk火箭集团1万亿美元估值，SpaceX概念杠杆ETF（SPCX/SPCH）短期承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s Net Worth Drops Below $900 Billion With SpaceX Nearing IPO Value
items.summary_cn: Musk净资产跌破9000亿美元，SpaceX临近IPO估值——SpaceX虽未上市但IPO预期升温，与kcn持有的SPCX/SPCH（SpaceX概念杠杆ETF）直接相关。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's xAI is now officially called SpaceXAI
items.summary_cn: Musk的xAI正式更名为SpaceXAI，AI与航天进一步整合（均为未上市公司，无可交易代码）。

items.author: Trump
items.text: One of the biggest Driving Forces in the Future for Jobs, are Data Centers. They are big, strong, bold, and Money Machines for the State in which they are built. Governor Kathy Hochul, for political reasons, has terminated all Data Centers being built, or to be built, in New York State. These Companies are now being sought in Alabama, Florida, Texas, Arizona, and many other States. Both the Taxes and the Jobs amount to LIQUID GOLD! New York State has made a terrible decision. All of this Income, and other Benefits, will be going to Red States, and some Blue, where Data Centers are sought as Ca
items.summary_cn: Trump抨击纽约州长Hochul终止数据中心建设，称公司将流向德州/佛州等红州，涉及AI基础设施主题。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Labor Department reports annual inflation in June was 3.5%, biggest monthly drop in over six years: https://justthenews.com/nation/economy/labor-department-reports-annual-inflation-june-was-35-biggest-monthly-drop-over-six
items.summary_cn: 6月美国年化通胀3.5%，月度降幅创六年新高，宏观通胀/利率利好信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk and Sam Altman accuse each other of scamming investors as each pitches their AI vision
items.summary_cn: Musk与Sam Altman互指对方欺骗投资者，AI行业领军人物口水战，关注AI板块情绪。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Pollution from Musk’s unpermitted xAI power project hits hardest in Black communities
items.summary_cn: Musk旗下未获许可的xAI发电项目污染问题，对黑人社区影响最大，涉及AI数据中心能源争议。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Oil is flowing like never before, thanks to the awesome Power of the United States Military. A special salute to Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Dan Caine, and Commander of the United States Central Command, Admiral Brad Cooper. Because of them, and all members of the Most Powerful Military anywhere in the World, BY FAR, the Strait of Hormuz is open to ALL Ship traffic except for Iran — and that is because of their lying, violent, malicious leadership, which is taking them down the path of TOTAL DESTRUCTION. We will therefore have a FULL Blockade, but onl
items.summary_cn: Trump称霍尔木兹海峡已对除伊朗外所有船只开放，美国对伊朗实施全面封锁，国际油价/能源供给受关注。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump claims military victory, points to economic progress in the wake of first-stage Iran deal: https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/jun/23/trump-claims-military-victory-points-economic-progress-wake-first/
items.summary_cn: Trump声称在伊朗第一阶段协议后取得军事胜利并强调经济进展，宏观利好信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump touts U.S. economy and oil prices in a midterm pitch in Pennsylvania: https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-touts-us-economy-oil-prices-midterm-pitch-pennsylvania-rcna351414
items.summary_cn: Trump在宾州中期选举造势中吹捧美国经济和油价，宏观正面信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump tells Pa. truck workers ‘fat drug’ prices coming down next week: ‘That alone should win the midterms’: https://nypost.com/2026/06/23/us-news/trump-tells-pa-truck-workers-fat-drug-prices-coming-down-next-week-that-alone-should-win-the-midterms/
items.summary_cn: Trump称下周将降低肥胖药物价格，药价/医保板块关注。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Trump visits Mack Trucks plant in battleground Pennsylvania district to tout economic agenda as midterms loom: https://www.foxbusiness.com/politics/trump-visits-mack-trucks-plant-battleground-pennsylvania-district-to-tout-economic-agenda-midterms-loom
items.summary_cn: Trump访问宾州Mack Trucks工厂宣传经济议程，制造/就业主题。
